in_sanskrit.name: Bipeen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bipeen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name 'Bipeen' is derived from Sanskrit language and is considered to be a unisex name in Hindu tradition. This name signifies the one who is the Lord of all Gods. The name is believed to bring blessings of strength, wisdom, and prosperity.
